t: The FloPlast push-fit boss pipe provides a reliable connection point within 110mm soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from lightweight, durable uPVC, it is engineered for long-lasting performance in various plumbing applications, including high-temperature waste discharges. This black single socket connector features three boss inlets, allowing trade professionals to efficiently integrate 32mm and 40mm waste pipes into a soil stack. Ideal for new installations or extending existing setups, its push-fit ring seal joints simplify assembly, ensuring a secure and leak-free drainage solution for various properties. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
b: Three Boss Inlets & Connects Multiple Waste Pipes
Suitable for High Temperature & Waste Discharges
